exercises.name: Ab Wheel
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Kneel on a mat with the wheel in front of you.
2. Hold the handles with your hands under your shoulders.
3. Tighten your stomach and keep your back straight.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Roll forward slowly.
2. Stop before your back arches.
3. Roll back to your knees and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Start with short rollouts.
- Keep your hips from dropping.
- Stop if your lower back hurts.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
2. Let your arms hang by your sides.
3. Keep your shoulders relaxed.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Make small circles with both arms.
2. Gradually make the circles larger.
3. Reverse the direction and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your arms light and relaxed.
- Do not shrug your shoulders.
- Stop if the movement causes pain.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Sit or stand tall with the weight at shoulder or chest height.
2. Use a stable position and choose a load you can control.
3. Brace your stomach and keep your feet planted.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Press the weight up along a comfortable path.
2. Stop when your arms are straight without shrugging.
3. Lower slowly to the start and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a weight you can control.
- Do not arch your back to finish a rep.
- Lower the weight if your path changes.

exercises.name: Back Extension
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Adjust the pad so your hips rest near its edge.
2. Secure your ankles and place your feet on the footplate.
3. Cross your arms over your chest and start with your body straight.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lower your chest by bending at your hips.
2. Raise your body by squeezing your glutes.
3. Stop when your body is straight and do not lean back.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Start with bodyweight.
- Keep your back straight as you move.
- Use a shorter range if needed.

exercises.name: Ball Slam
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Choose a medicine ball made for slamming and clear the area.
2. Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and hold the ball with both hands.
3. Keep your knees slightly bent and your stomach tight.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lift the ball overhead.
2. Slam it down while bending your knees.
3. Pick it up with bent knees, reset your stance, and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a ball that will not bounce unpredictably.
- Keep other people away from the ball.
- Focus on control instead of speed.

exercises.name: Barbell Squat
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Set the bar in a rack and place it across your upper back.
2. Step back and place your feet about shoulder-width apart.
3. Keep your chest up and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your hips and knees to lower your body.
2. Keep your knees pointed toward your toes.
3. Push through the floor to stand tall.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Squat only as low as you can control.
- Keep your heels down.
- Use the rack safeties and a load you can control.

exercises.name: Bench Press - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Sit or stand tall with the weight at shoulder or chest height.
2. Set the bar and plates safely before starting.
3. Brace your stomach and keep your feet planted.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Press the weight up along a comfortable path.
2. Stop when your arms are straight without shrugging.
3. Lower slowly to the start and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a weight you can control.
- Do not arch your back to finish a rep.
- Lower the weight if your path changes.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand or sit tall with your elbows close to your sides.
2. Set the bar and plates safely before starting.
3. Start with your arms straight and your wrists steady.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your elbows to raise the weight.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your elbows still.
- Do not swing your body.
- Use a lighter weight if you cannot control the lowering.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl - Bodyweight
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand or sit tall with your elbows close to your sides.
2. Place one hand under the other forearm.
3. Keep both wrists straight and start with your arms relaxed.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Pull up gently with the lower hand while the other hand resists.
2. Pause briefly with the working arm bent.
3. Lower slowly and repeat on both sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your elbows close to your body.
- Use steady pressure instead of jerking.
- Stop if your elbow or wrist hurts.

exercises.setupNotes:

exercises.name: Bicep Curl - Resistance Band
exercises.setupNotes:

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch - Bent Knees
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet off the floor.
2. Place your hands behind your head without pulling on your neck.
3. Lift your shoulders slightly from the floor.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bring your right elbow toward your left knee.
2. Return to the middle and switch sides.
3. Keep alternating slowly and smoothly.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your lower back close to the floor.
- Move your shoulders rather than pulling your head.
- Use a smaller range if your neck or back hurts.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch - Straight Knees
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with your legs straight and slightly raised.
2. Place your hands behind your head without pulling on your neck.
3. Lift your shoulders slightly from the floor.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bring your right shoulder toward your left leg as it lifts.
2. Return to the middle and switch sides.
3. Keep alternating slowly and smoothly.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your lower back close to the floor.
- Keep your legs moving in a controlled path.
- Bend your knees if straight legs are too difficult.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand a step in front of a bench or sturdy surface.
2. Place one foot behind you on the surface.
3. Keep your chest up and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend both knees to lower your body slowly.
2. Push through your front foot to stand tall.
3. Finish your repetitions and switch sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your front heel down.
- Use a small range while learning.
- Hold a support if you need better balance.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Set the bar in a rack and place it across your upper back.
2. Stand a step in front of a bench and place one foot behind you on it.
3. Keep your chest up and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend both knees to lower your body slowly.
2. Keep your front knee pointed toward your toes.
3. Push through your front foot to stand tall, then switch sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Practice the movement without weight first.
- Keep your front heel down.
- Use a rack and a light load until your balance is steady.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Clear a flat area and stand with your feet about hip-width apart.
2. Choose whether you will step or jump between positions.
3. Brace your stomach before starting.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend down and place your hands on the floor.
2. Step or jump your feet back into a plank.
3. Bring your feet forward, stand up, and jump softly if you choose.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use the step version for less impact.
- Keep your back straight in the plank.
- Add a push-up only if that is your chosen variation.

exercises.name: Calf Press
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Sit in the leg press and place the balls of your feet on the platform.
2. Keep your legs nearly straight and unlock the safety stops.
3. Use a light load and keep your feet about hip-width apart.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Raise your heels as high as you can.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly without bouncing and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your ankles straight.
- Use a comfortable range of motion.
- Use the safety stops and a load you can control.

exercises.name: Calf Raise - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand with your feet about hip-width apart.
2. Choose a weight you can control.
3. Use a wall or rail for balance if needed.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Raise your heels as high as you can.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly without bouncing and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your ankles straight.
- Use a comfortable range of motion.
- Use lighter weights if balance is difficult.

exercises.name: Calf Raise - Seated Calf Raise Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Sit with the balls of your feet on the footplate.
2. Place the pads on your thighs and hold the handles.
3. Keep your feet about hip-width apart and start with a light load.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Raise your heels as high as you can.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly without bouncing and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your ankles straight.
- Use a comfortable range of motion.
- Use the safety stops and a load you can control.

exercises.name: Calf Raise - Standing Calf Raise Machine
exercises.setupNotes:

2. Place the pads on your shoulders or hold the handles.
3. Keep your feet about hip-width apart and start with a light load.
exercises.executionNotes:

2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly without bouncing and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:

- Use a comfortable range of motion.
- Use the safety stops and a load you can control.

exercises.name: Chest Dip
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Grip the parallel bars and support yourself with straight arms.
2. Brace your stomach and keep a stable position.
3. Lean slightly forward and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your elbows and lower yourself slowly.
2. Stop at a comfortable depth.
3. Press through the bars to return to the top.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use an assisted dip machine while learning.
- Do not bounce at the bottom.
- Stop if your shoulders hurt.

exercises.name: Chest Dip - Assisted Dip/Pull-Up Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Set enough assistance to control the movement.
2. Hold the parallel bars and place your knees or feet on the support.
3. Start with straight arms and lean slightly forward.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your elbows and lower your body slowly.
2. Stop at a comfortable depth.
3. Press through the bars to return to the top.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use more assistance if you cannot press up smoothly.
- Do not bounce at the bottom.
- Step off the moving support carefully when finished.

exercises.name: Chest Dip - Dip Bars
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Grip the parallel bars and support yourself with straight arms.
2. Use a stable position and choose a load you can control.
3. Lean slightly forward and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:

2. Stop at a comfortable depth.
3. Press through the bars to return to the top.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use an assisted dip machine while learning.
- Do not bounce at the bottom.
- Stop if your shoulders hurt.

exercises.name: Chest Fly - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on the bench or stand at the cable station.
2. Set the cable and attachment at a comfortable height.
3. Keep a small bend in your elbows.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Open your arms slowly.
2. Stop when your chest is comfortably stretched.
3. Bring your hands together and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep the same elbow bend throughout.
- Do not drop into the stretch.
- Use a lighter weight if your shoulders hurt.

exercises.name: Chest Fly - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on the bench or stand at the cable station.
2. Choose a weight you can control.
3. Keep a small bend in your elbows.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Open your arms slowly.
2. Stop when your chest is comfortably stretched.
3. Bring your hands together and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep the same elbow bend throughout.
- Do not drop into the stretch.
- Use a lighter weight if your shoulders hurt.

exercises.name: Chest Press - Chest Press Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Sit or stand tall with the weight at shoulder or chest height.
2. Adjust the seat and pads to fit you.
3. Brace your stomach and keep your feet planted.
exercises.executionNotes:

2. Stop when your arms are straight without shrugging.
3. Lower slowly to the start and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:

- Do not arch your back to finish a rep.
- Lower the weight if your path changes.

exercises.name: Chin Up
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Grip the bar securely with your hands at the chosen width.
2. Start from a controlled hang with your shoulders active.
3. Use assistance or a band if needed.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Pull your chest toward the bar.
2. Pause near the top without swinging.
3. Lower slowly to the starting hang.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use an assisted machine while building strength.
- Keep your body steady.
- Stop if your grip or shoulders lose control.

exercises.name: Chin Up - Assisted Dip/Pull-Up Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Set enough assistance to control the movement.
2. Hold the pull-up handles with your palms facing you.
3. Place your knees or feet on the support and start with straight arms.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Pull your chest toward the handles.
2. Pause near the top without swinging.
3. Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use more assistance if you cannot lower slowly.
- Keep your body steady.
- Step off the moving support carefully when finished.

exercises.name: Clean - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand over the bar with your feet about hip-width apart.
2. Grip the bar and keep your back flat.
3. Start with a light weight and a clear area.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Push the floor away and pull the bar close to your body.
2. Catch the bar on the front of your shoulders.
3. Stand tall, then lower the bar safely.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Learn the movement with a light bar first.
- Keep the bar close and do not pull with your arms alone.
- Get coaching before using heavy weights.

exercises.name: Clean and Press - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand over the bar with your feet about hip-width apart.
2. Grip the bar and keep it close to your legs.
3. Start with a light weight and a clear area.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lift the bar to your shoulders in one smooth pull.
2. Stand tall, then press the bar overhead.
3. Lower it to your shoulders and then to the floor under control.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Learn the clean and press separately first.
- Do not swing or jerk the bar.
- Stop if the catch or press becomes uncontrolled.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Sit and place the back of your upper arm against your inner thigh.
2. Set the cable and attachment at a comfortable height.
3. Start with your arm straight and your wrist steady.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your elbow to raise the weight.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly until your arm is straight and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your upper arm still.
- Do not swing the weight.
- Use a lighter weight if you cannot control the lowering.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with your knees bent.
2. Brace your stomach and keep a stable position.
3. Place your hands where they can support your head or sides without pulling.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lift your upper body or shoulder from the floor.
2. Move toward the target side or position.
3. Lower slowly and repeat on both sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your neck relaxed.
- Use a smaller range if your back lifts.
- Move slowly instead of pulling with your hands.

exercises.name: Crunch - Dumbbell (Seated)
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Sit with your feet flat and hold the weight close to your chest.
2. Keep your back tall and brace your stomach.
3. Use a light weight while learning.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lean back a short distance under control.
2. Sit tall again without swinging.
3. Repeat at a steady pace.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a small range at first.
- Keep your feet planted.
- Stop if your lower back hurts.

exercises.name: Cuban Rotation
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
2. Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees and keep them near your sides.
3. Keep your chest up and start with your forearms pointing forward.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Rotate your forearms up and back slowly.
2. Stop when your hands are near shoulder height.
3. Return to the start and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your elbows in place.
- Use a small range and move slowly.
- Stop if your shoulder pinches or hurts.

exercises.name: Cuban Rotation - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand or sit tall with your elbow close to your side.
2. Choose a weight you can control.
3. Use a light weight or resistance.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Rotate your forearm slowly to the chosen side.
2. Stop at a comfortable range.
3. Return to the start and repeat on both sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your upper arm still.
- Use a very light load.
- Stop if your shoulder pinches or hurts.

exercises.name: Curtsey Lunge
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart.
2. Brace your stomach and keep a stable position.
3. Brace your stomach before moving.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Step one foot forward or to the side and lower your body slowly.
2. Keep the front foot flat and the knee pointed toward the toes.
3. Push through the front foot to return and switch sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a shorter step if your balance is limited.
- Hold a support while learning.
- Stop if your knee caves inward or becomes painful.

exercises.name: Curtsey Lunge - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:

2. Choose a weight you can control.
3. Brace your stomach before moving.
exercises.executionNotes:

3. Push through the front foot to return and switch sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a shorter step if your balance is limited.
- Hold a support while learning.
- Stop if your knee caves inward or becomes painful.

exercises.name: Deadlift - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand with your feet about hip-width apart.
2. Set the bar and plates safely before starting.
3. Keep your back flat and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Move your hips back and keep the weight close.
2. Stand up by pushing through your feet.
3. Lower slowly by moving your hips back first, then repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Start with a light weight.
- Do not round your back or jerk the weight.
- Use a shorter range if your balance or form changes.

exercises.name: Deadlift - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand with your feet about hip-width apart.
2. Choose a weight you can control.
3. Keep your back flat and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Move your hips back and keep the weight close.
2. Stand up by pushing through your feet.
3. Lower slowly by moving your hips back first, then repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Start with a light weight.
- Do not round your back or jerk the weight.
- Use a shorter range if your balance or form changes.

exercises.name: Deadlift - Landmine Attachment
exercises.setupNotes:

2. Use a stable position and choose a load you can control.
3. Keep your back flat and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:

2. Stand up by pushing through your feet.
3. Lower slowly by moving your hips back first, then repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Start with a light weight.
- Do not round your back or jerk the weight.
- Use a shorter range if your balance or form changes.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-up
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Start with your hands on the floor about shoulder-width apart.
2. Keep your body straight, or use your knees or an incline.
3. Brace your stomach before lowering.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your elbows and lower your chest slowly.
2. Push the floor away to return to the top.
3. Repeat without letting your hips sag.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use an incline or your knees to make it easier.
- Keep your elbows at a comfortable angle.
- Stop if your wrists or shoulders hurt.

exercises.name: Donkey Kick
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Start on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
2. Keep your back level and brace your stomach.
3. Brace your stomach and keep a stable position.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Move one leg back slowly.
2. Pause briefly without turning your hips.
3. Lower the leg and repeat on both sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your hips level.
- Use a small range if your back moves.
- Do not swing the leg.

exercises.name: Down-Up Twist - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Set the cable low and hold the handle with both hands.
2. Stand sideways to the machine with your feet planted.
3. Start with the handle beside the hip nearest the cable.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Pull the handle diagonally across your body and upward.
2. Turn your torso slowly while keeping your feet in place.
3. Return to the start under control, then switch sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a light weight while learning the path.
- Keep your arms relaxed and let your torso turn.
- Do not jerk the cable or twist beyond a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Drag Curl - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand or sit tall with your elbows close to your sides.
2. Set the bar and plates safely before starting.
3. Start with your arms straight and your wrists steady.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your elbows to raise the weight.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your elbows still.
- Do not swing your body.
- Use a lighter weight if you cannot control the lowering.

exercises.name: Drag Curl - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand or sit tall with your elbows close to your sides.
2. Set the cable and attachment at a comfortable height.
3. Start with your arms straight and your wrists steady.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your elbows to raise the weight.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your elbows still.
- Do not swing your body.
- Use a lighter weight if you cannot control the lowering.

exercises.name: Drag Curl - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand or sit tall with your elbows close to your sides.
2. Choose a weight you can control.
3. Start with your arms straight and your wrists steady.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your elbows to raise the weight.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your elbows still.
- Do not swing your body.
- Use a lighter weight if you cannot control the lowering.

exercises.name: External Rotation - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand or sit tall with your elbow close to your side.
2. Set the cable and attachment at a comfortable height.
3. Use a light weight or resistance.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Rotate your forearm slowly to the chosen side.
2. Stop at a comfortable range.
3. Return to the start and repeat on both sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your upper arm still.
- Use a very light load.
- Stop if your shoulder pinches or hurts.

exercises.name: External Rotation - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand or sit tall with your elbow close to your side.
2. Choose a weight you can control.
3. Use a light weight or resistance.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Rotate your forearm slowly to the chosen side.
2. Stop at a comfortable range.
3. Return to the start and repeat on both sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your upper arm still.
- Use a very light load.
- Stop if your shoulder pinches or hurts.

exercises.name: Face Pull - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand tall and hold the band or rope in front of you.
2. Set the cable and attachment at a comfortable height.
3. Keep your arms slightly bent and your stomach tight.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Pull the band or rope toward your face or upper chest.
2. Pause briefly with your hands apart.
3. Return slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your shoulders down.
- Use light resistance.
- Do not lean back or swing.

exercises.name: Farmers Carry - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Choose a load you can carry safely.
2. Stand tall and hold the weight securely.
3. Clear a straight walking path.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Walk forward with steady steps.
2. Keep the weights close and your body tall.
3. Stop and set the weights down carefully.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a shorter path while learning.
- Do not lean or rush.
- Set the weights down instead of dropping them.

exercises.name: Fire Hydrant
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Start on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
2. Keep your back level and brace your stomach.
3. Brace your stomach and keep a stable position.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lift one knee out to the side slowly.
2. Pause briefly without turning your hips.
3. Lower the leg and repeat on both sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your hips level.
- Use a small range if your back moves.
- Do not swing the leg.

exercises.name: Floor Press - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie under a bar set in a low rack with your knees bent.
2. Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
3. Unrack the bar and hold it over your chest with straight arms.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lower the bar until your upper arms rest lightly on the floor.
2. Pause without letting your elbows bounce.
3. Press the bar back over your chest and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a rack with safety supports or ask for help unracking.
- Keep your wrists above your elbows.
- Lower the weight if you cannot pause under control.

exercises.name: Floor Press - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Sit on the floor with a dumbbell on each thigh.
2. Lie back, bend your knees, and hold the dumbbells over your chest.
3. Keep your wrists straight and your upper arms just above the floor.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lower the dumbbells until your upper arms rest lightly on the floor.
2. Pause without letting your elbows bounce.
3. Press the dumbbells over your chest and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a weight you can move safely into position.
- Keep your wrists above your elbows.
- Lower the weight if you cannot pause under control.

exercises.name: Front Raise - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand or sit tall with the weight at your sides.
2. Set the bar and plates safely before starting.
3. Keep your knees soft and your stomach tight.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Raise the weight along a comfortable path.
2. Stop around shoulder height or sooner if needed.
3. Lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a light weight.
- Do not swing or shrug.
- Stop if your shoulders hurt.

exercises.name: Front Raise - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand or sit tall with the weight at your sides.
2. Set the cable and attachment at a comfortable height.
3. Keep your knees soft and your stomach tight.
exercises.executionNotes:

2. Stop around shoulder height or sooner if needed.

exercises.tipsNotes:

exercises.name: Front Raise - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand or sit tall with the weight at your sides.
2. Choose a weight you can control.
3. Keep your knees soft and your stomach tight.
exercises.executionNotes:

- Stop if your shoulders hurt.

exercises.name: Front Squat - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Set the bar in a rack at a safe height.
2. Rest it across the front of your shoulders and grip it securely.
3. Step back, set your feet, and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your hips and knees to lower your body.
2. Keep your chest tall and your feet flat.
3. Push through the floor to stand tall.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a light weight while learning the bar position.
- Keep your knees pointed toward your toes.
- Lower the weight if your chest drops.

exercises.name: Front Squat - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Set the cable low and hold the rope close to your chest.
2. Step back and place your feet about shoulder-width apart.
3. Keep your chest up and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your hips and knees to lower your body.
2. Keep your chest tall and your feet flat.
3. Push through the floor to stand tall.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a light weight while learning.
- Keep your knees pointed toward your toes.
- Lower the weight if the cable pulls you forward.

exercises.name: Front Squat - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Hold one dumbbell at your chest or two at your shoulders.
2. Place your feet about shoulder-width apart.
3. Keep your chest up and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your hips and knees to lower your body.
2. Keep your chest tall and your feet flat.
3. Push through the floor to stand tall.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Start with a light weight.
- Keep your knees pointed toward your toes.
- Lower the weight if your chest drops.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with your feet flat and knees bent.
2. Brace your stomach and keep a stable position.
3. Keep your feet about hip-width apart.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Push through your feet to raise your hips.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your ribs down.
- Do not arch your back at the top.
- Use bodyweight until the movement feels steady.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with your feet flat and knees bent.
2. Set the bar and plates safely before starting.
3. Keep your feet about hip-width apart.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Push through your feet to raise your hips.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your ribs down.
- Do not arch your back at the top.
- Use bodyweight until the movement feels steady.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with your feet flat and knees bent.
2. Choose a weight you can control.
3. Keep your feet about hip-width apart.
exercises.executionNotes:

3. Lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:

- Use bodyweight until the movement feels steady.

exercises.name: Glute Ham Raise
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Adjust the machine so your knees rest on the pad.
2. Secure your feet and keep your body straight.
3. Start with bodyweight.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lower your body slowly from the knees.
2. Use your hamstrings to pull yourself back up.
3. Return to the starting position without swinging.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a shorter range while learning.
- Keep your hips from folding.
- Use assistance if you cannot control the lowering.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand tall and hold a stable support.
2. Keep your hips facing forward and brace your stomach.
3. Keep the working leg slightly behind you.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Move one leg back slowly.
2. Pause briefly without leaning forward.
3. Return the leg to the start and repeat on both sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a small range at first.
- Keep your hips level.
- Do not swing the leg or arch your back.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Attach the ankle cuff and stand facing the cable machine.
2. Hold the machine for balance and keep your hips facing forward.
3. Choose a light weight and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Move one leg back slowly.
2. Pause briefly without leaning forward.
3. Return the leg to the start and repeat on both sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a small range at first.
- Keep your hips level.
- Do not swing the leg or arch your back.

exercises.name: Good Morning - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Place the bar across your upper back and step away from the rack.
2. Stand with your feet about hip-width apart.
3. Brace your stomach and keep your back flat.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Move your hips back and lower your chest slightly.
2. Stop when you can keep your back flat.
3. Push your hips forward to stand tall and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a light weight while learning.
- Keep the bar on your back, not your neck.
- Do not round your back or lean too far forward.

exercises.name: Hack Squat - Hack Squat Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
2. Adjust the seat and pads to fit you.
3. Brace your stomach and keep your feet flat.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your hips and knees to lower your body.
2. Keep your knees pointed toward your toes.
3. Push through the floor to stand tall.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Squat only as low as you can control.
- Keep your heels down.
- Lower the weight if your form changes.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand or sit tall with your elbows close to your sides.
2. Set the cable and attachment at a comfortable height.
3. Start with your arms straight and your wrists steady.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your elbows to raise the weight.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
exercises.tipsNotes:

- Do not swing your body.
- Use a lighter weight if you cannot control the lowering.

- Use a lighter weight if you cannot control the lowering.

exercises.name: Hang Clean - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand over the bar with your feet about hip-width apart.
2. Grip the bar and keep your back flat.
3. Start with a light weight and a clear area.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Push the floor away and pull the bar close to your body.
2. Catch the bar on the front of your shoulders.
3. Stand tall, then lower the bar safely.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Learn the movement with a light bar first.
- Keep the bar close and do not pull with your arms alone.
- Get coaching before using heavy weights.

exercises.name: Hang Snatch - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand over the bar with your feet about hip-width apart.
2. Use a wide grip and keep your back flat.
3. Start with a light weight and a clear area.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Push the floor away and pull the bar close to your body.
2. Catch the bar overhead with soft knees.
3. Stand tall, then lower the bar safely.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Practice with a light bar before adding weight.
- Keep the bar close and move smoothly.
- Get coaching before using heavy weights.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Hang from the bar with a firm grip.
2. Keep your shoulders active and your legs together.
3. Start with bent knees if needed.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lift your knees or feet toward the bar.
2. Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
3. Repeat from a controlled hang.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use bent knees to make it easier.
- Keep the movement smooth.
- Stop if your grip or shoulders become unsafe.

exercises.name: Heel Touch
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
2. Place your arms by your sides.
3. Lift your shoulders slightly from the floor.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Reach your right hand toward your right heel.
2. Return to the middle and reach toward the left heel.
3. Keep alternating from side to side.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your neck relaxed.
- Move your shoulders instead of pulling your head.
- Use a smaller range if your back lifts.

exercises.name: High Pull - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand with your feet about hip-width apart.
2. Set the bar and plates safely before starting.
3. Hold the weight in front of your thighs and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lift the weight by driving through your feet and raising your elbows.
2. Bring the weight to about chest height.
3. Lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a light weight while learning.
- Keep the weight close to your body.
- Stop if your shoulders or wrists hurt.

exercises.name: High Pull - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand with your feet about hip-width apart.
2. Choose a weight you can control.
3. Hold the weight in front of your thighs and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lift the weight by driving through your feet and raising your elbows.
2. Bring the weight to about chest height.
3. Lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a light weight while learning.
- Keep the weight close to your body.
- Stop if your shoulders or wrists hurt.

exercises.name: Hip Abductor - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Attach a low cable to the ankle farthest from the machine.
2. Stand sideways and hold the machine for balance.
3. Keep your hips facing forward and start with both feet together.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Move the cuffed leg away from the machine slowly.
2. Pause without leaning or turning your hips.
3. Return under control, then switch sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your foot pointing forward.
- Use a small range and a light weight.
- Do not swing your leg or lean sideways.

exercises.name: Hip Adductor - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Attach a low cable to the ankle nearest the machine.
2. Stand sideways and hold the machine for balance.
3. Move the cuffed foot slightly toward the machine to start.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Pull the cuffed leg across the front of your body slowly.
2. Pause without leaning or turning your hips.
3. Return under control, then switch sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your foot pointing forward.
- Use a small range and a light weight.
- Do not swing your leg or lean sideways.

exercises.name: Hip Extension
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand tall and hold a stable support.
2. Keep your hips facing forward and your stomach braced.
3. Start with both feet under your hips.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Move one leg straight back without leaning forward.
2. Pause briefly at the end of the movement.
3. Return the leg and switch sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a small range at first.
- Keep the supporting leg steady.
- Do not swing the working leg.

exercises.name: Hip Flexion
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand tall and hold a stable support.
2. Keep your hips facing forward and your stomach braced.
3. Start with both feet under your hips.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lift one knee forward without leaning back.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower the leg and switch sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a small range at first.
- Keep the supporting leg steady.
- Do not swing the working leg.

exercises.name: Hip Frog Extension
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together.
2. Bring your feet close and let your knees open.
3. Keep your back relaxed on the floor.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lift your hips by squeezing your glutes.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your feet together.
- Do not arch your back.
- Use bodyweight while learning.

exercises.name: Hip Raise
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with your feet flat and knees bent.
2. Brace your stomach and keep a stable position.
3. Keep your feet about hip-width apart.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Push through your feet to raise your hips.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your ribs down.
- Do not arch your back at the top.
- Use bodyweight until the movement feels steady.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Rest your upper back on a bench with your feet flat on the floor.
2. Set the bar and plates safely before starting.
3. Place the load securely across your hips and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lower your hips slightly to start.
2. Push through your feet to raise your hips.
3. Pause briefly at the top, then lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your chin slightly tucked.
- Do not arch your back at the top.
- Use a lighter load if the setup shifts.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Rest your upper back on a bench with your feet flat on the floor.
2. Set the cable and attachment at a comfortable height.
3. Place the load securely across your hips and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lower your hips slightly to start.
2. Push through your feet to raise your hips.
3. Pause briefly at the top, then lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your chin slightly tucked.
- Do not arch your back at the top.
- Use a lighter load if the setup shifts.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust - Hip Thrust Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Adjust the machine so your upper back and hips are supported.
2. Place your feet flat and set the pad or belt securely.
3. Start with a light load and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lower your hips slightly to start.
2. Push through your feet to raise your hips.
3. Pause briefly at the top, then lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your chin slightly tucked.
- Do not arch your back at the top.
- Use a lighter load if the setup shifts.

exercises.name: In-And-Out
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with your legs extended or bent.
2. Brace your stomach and keep a stable position.
3. Keep your back flat and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lift your legs and upper body toward each other.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Bend your knees to make it easier.
- Use a smaller range while learning.
- Do not swing or pull on your neck.

exercises.name: In-And-Out - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with your legs extended or bent.
2. Choose a weight you can control.
3. Keep your back flat and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lift your legs and upper body toward each other.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Bend your knees to make it easier.
- Use a smaller range while learning.
- Do not swing or pull on your neck.

exercises.name: Incline Around the World - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on an incline bench with a light dumbbell in each hand.
2. Start with your palms up and the dumbbells beside your hips.
3. Keep a small bend in your elbows.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Sweep both dumbbells out and upward in a wide arc.
2. Bring them close together above your head without forcing the range.
3. Follow the same arc back to your hips and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use very light weights.
- Keep the same bend in your elbows.
- Stop before your shoulders become uncomfortable.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Fly - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on the bench or stand at the cable station.
2. Set the cable and attachment at a comfortable height.
3. Keep a small bend in your elbows.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Open your arms slowly.
2. Stop when your chest is comfortably stretched.
3. Bring your hands together and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep the same elbow bend throughout.
- Do not drop into the stretch.
- Use a lighter weight if your shoulders hurt.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Fly - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on the bench or stand at the cable station.
2. Choose a weight you can control.
3. Keep a small bend in your elbows.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Open your arms slowly.
2. Stop when your chest is comfortably stretched.
3. Bring your hands together and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep the same elbow bend throughout.
- Do not drop into the stretch.
- Use a lighter weight if your shoulders hurt.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Sit or stand tall with the weight at shoulder or chest height.
2. Set the bar and plates safely before starting.
3. Brace your stomach and keep your feet planted.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Press the weight up along a comfortable path.
2. Stop when your arms are straight without shrugging.
3. Lower slowly to the start and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a weight you can control.
- Do not arch your back to finish a rep.
- Lower the weight if your path changes.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Sit or stand tall with the weight at shoulder or chest height.
2. Set the cable and attachment at a comfortable height.
3. Brace your stomach and keep your feet planted.
exercises.executionNotes:

2. Stop when your arms are straight without shrugging.
3. Lower slowly to the start and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press - Dumbbell

exercises.executionNotes:

exercises.name: Incline Bicep Curl - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand or sit tall with your elbows close to your sides.
2. Choose a weight you can control.
3. Start with your arms straight and your wrists steady.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your elbows to raise the weight.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your elbows still.
- Do not swing your body.
- Use a lighter weight if you cannot control the lowering.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Press - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Sit or stand tall with the weight at shoulder or chest height.
2. Set the bar and plates safely before starting.
3. Brace your stomach and keep your feet planted.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Press the weight up along a comfortable path.
2. Stop when your arms are straight without shrugging.
3. Lower slowly to the start and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a weight you can control.
- Do not arch your back to finish a rep.
- Lower the weight if your path changes.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Press - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Sit or stand tall with the weight at shoulder or chest height.
2. Choose a weight you can control.
3. Brace your stomach and keep your feet planted.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Press the weight up along a comfortable path.
2. Stop when your arms are straight without shrugging.
3. Lower slowly to the start and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a weight you can control.
- Do not arch your back to finish a rep.
- Lower the weight if your path changes.

exercises.name: Incline Leg Press
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Adjust the seat so your knees are comfortable at the start.
2. Use a stable position and choose a load you can control.
3. Place your feet about shoulder-width apart on the platform.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lower the platform by bending your knees slowly.
2. Stop before your lower back lifts from the pad.
3. Push the platform away and return without locking your knees hard.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your feet flat on the platform.
- Do not let your knees fall inward.
- Use the safety stops and a weight you can control.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Place your hands on a stable bench or raised surface.
2. Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line.
3. Brace your stomach before lowering.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the surface.
2. Push through your hands to return to the top.
3. Repeat without letting your hips sag.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a higher surface to make the exercise easier.
- Keep your elbows at a comfortable angle.
- Make sure the surface cannot move.

exercises.name: Incline Reverse Fly - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand or lie with your chest supported and your back steady.
2. Choose a weight you can control.
3. Let your arms hang with a small bend in your elbows.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Move your arms out to the sides.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a light weight.
- Keep your shoulders down.
- Do not swing or twist.

exercises.name: Incline Row - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Set your body so your back is flat and your chest is supported or steady.
2. Set the cable and attachment at a comfortable height.
3. Let your arms reach forward without rounding your back.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Pull the handle or weight toward your ribs.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your shoulders down.
- Do not twist or jerk the weight.
- Use a lighter weight if your back moves.

exercises.name: Incline Row - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Set your body so your back is flat and your chest is supported or steady.
2. Choose a weight you can control.
3. Let your arms reach forward without rounding your back.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Pull the handle or weight toward your ribs.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your shoulders down.
- Do not twist or jerk the weight.
- Use a lighter weight if your back moves.

exercises.name: Internal Rotation - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand or sit tall with your elbow close to your side.
2. Set the cable and attachment at a comfortable height.
3. Use a light weight or resistance.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Rotate your forearm slowly to the chosen side.
2. Stop at a comfortable range.
3. Return to the start and repeat on both sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your upper arm still.
- Use a very light load.
- Stop if your shoulder pinches or hurts.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Set a bar low enough that you can reach it safely.
2. Hold the bar with your hands just wider than your shoulders.
3. Keep your body straight with your heels on the floor.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Pull your chest toward the bar.
2. Pause briefly when your chest is close to the bar.
3. Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your hips in line with your shoulders.
- Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
- Bend your knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: Inverted Row (Reverse Grip)
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Set a bar low enough that you can reach it safely.
2. Hold the bar with your palms facing toward you.
3. Keep your body straight with your heels on the floor.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Pull your chest toward the bar.
2. Pause briefly when your chest is close to the bar.
3. Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your hips in line with your shoulders.
- Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
- Bend your knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: Jump Squat
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
2. Brace your stomach and keep a stable position.
3. Brace your stomach and keep your arms ready to balance.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your hips and knees into a comfortable squat.
2. Jump up from the floor.
3. Land softly, settle your stance, and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a regular squat if you need less impact.
- Land with soft knees.
- Stop if you cannot control the landing.

exercises.name: Jump Squat - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
2. Choose a weight you can control.
3. Brace your stomach and keep your arms ready to balance.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your hips and knees into a comfortable squat.
2. Jump up from the floor.
3. Land softly, settle your stance, and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a regular squat if you need less impact.
- Land with soft knees.
- Stop if you cannot control the landing.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swings
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and hold the weight in front of you.
2. Keep your knees slightly bent and your back flat.
3. Start with a light weight and clear the area.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Hinge at your hips and swing the weight between your legs.
2. Drive your hips forward to bring it to chest height.
3. Let it swing back and repeat without lifting it with your arms.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep the weight close and the swing controlled.
- Do not squat deeply or lean back at the top.
- Stop if your back rounds or the weight pulls you off balance.

exercises.name: Knee Push-Up
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Start with your hands on the floor about shoulder-width apart.
2. Keep your body straight, or use your knees or an incline.
3. Brace your stomach before lowering.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your elbows and lower your chest slowly.
2. Push the floor away to return to the top.
3. Repeat without letting your hips sag.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use an incline or your knees to make it easier.
- Keep your elbows at a comfortable angle.
- Stop if your wrists or shoulders hurt.

exercises.name: Knee Raise
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with your legs together.
2. Place your hands by your sides or under your hips.
3. Keep your back flat before lifting.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Raise your legs slowly.
2. Stop before your back lifts from the floor.
3. Lower your legs under control and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Bend your knees to make it easier.
- Do not swing your legs.
- Use a smaller range if your back arches.

exercises.name: Knee Raise (Hanging)
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Hang from the bar with a firm grip.
2. Keep your shoulders active and your legs together.
3. Start with bent knees if needed.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lift your knees or feet toward the bar.
2. Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
3. Repeat from a controlled hang.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use bent knees to make it easier.
- Keep the movement smooth.
- Stop if your grip or shoulders become unsafe.

exercises.name: Knee Raise Twist
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Hold a pull-up bar or use a supported knee-raise station.
2. Keep your shoulders down and your legs hanging.
3. Brace your stomach before lifting your knees.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Raise your knees toward one side.
2. Lower them slowly to the middle.
3. Repeat on the other side.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep the movement controlled.
- Do not swing your body.
- Use a smaller range if your grip or back loses control.

exercises.name: Kneeling Crunch - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Kneel facing the cable and hold the rope near your head.
2. Set the cable and attachment at a comfortable height.
3. Keep your hips steady and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Curl your ribs toward your hips.
2. Pause briefly at the bottom.
3. Return slowly to the starting position.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Move your upper body instead of pulling with your arms.
- Keep your hips over your knees.
- Use a lighter weight if your back rounds too much.

exercises.name: Kneeling Plank
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Start on your hands and knees.
2. Place your hands under your shoulders and keep your knees under your hips.
3. Brace your stomach and keep your back flat.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Hold the position while breathing normally.
2. Keep your hips level and your back steady.
3. Lower your knees or hips when the hold is over.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Start with a short hold.
- Do not let your lower back sag.
- Rest when you cannot keep a straight line.

exercises.name: Kneeling Pull-down
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Kneel in front of a high cable and hold the bar with straight arms.
2. Keep your torso upright and your knees firmly planted.
3. Brace your stomach before pulling.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Pull the bar or handle toward your upper chest.
2. Pause briefly without leaning far back.
3. Let your arms straighten slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your shoulders down.
- Do not lean back to move the weight.
- Use a lighter weight if you need to swing.

exercises.name: Kneeling Tricep Extension
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Kneel facing away from a high cable.
2. Hold the rope behind your head with your elbows pointing forward.
3. Brace your stomach and keep your upper arms still.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Straighten your elbows to move the rope forward.
2. Pause with your arms straight.
3. Bend your elbows slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your upper arms still.
- Do not arch your back.
- Use a lighter weight if your elbows move.

exercises.name: Landmine Press - Landmine Attachment
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Sit or stand tall with the weight at shoulder or chest height.
2. Use a stable position and choose a load you can control.
3. Brace your stomach and keep your feet planted.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Press the weight up along a comfortable path.
2. Stop when your arms are straight without shrugging.
3. Lower slowly to the start and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a weight you can control.
- Do not arch your back to finish a rep.
- Lower the weight if your path changes.

exercises.name: Landmine Thruster - Landmine Attachment
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Hold the weight at shoulder height.
2. Use a stable position and choose a load you can control.
3. Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lower into a comfortable squat.
2. Stand up and press the weight overhead.
3. Lower the weight to your shoulders and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a light weight while learning.
- Keep your feet flat and knees pointed toward your toes.
- Slow down if the press becomes uncontrolled.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Sit with your thighs secured under the pad.
2. Set the cable and attachment at a comfortable height.
3. Grip the bar or handle and sit tall.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Pull the bar or handle toward your upper chest.
2. Pause briefly without leaning far back.
3. Let your arms straighten slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your shoulders down.
- Do not pull behind your neck.
- Use a lighter weight if you need to swing.

exercises.tipsNotes:

exercises.name: Lateral Raise - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand or sit tall with the weight at your sides.
2. Set the cable and attachment at a comfortable height.
3. Keep your knees soft and your stomach tight.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Raise the weight along a comfortable path.
2. Stop around shoulder height or sooner if needed.
3. Lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a light weight.
- Do not swing or shrug.
- Stop if your shoulders hurt.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise - Dumbbell (Bent Arm)
exercises.setupNotes:

exercises.setupNotes:

2. Adjust the seat and pads to fit you.
3. Keep your knees soft and your stomach tight.

2. Stop around shoulder height or sooner if needed.
3. Lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a light weight.
- Do not swing or shrug.
- Stop if your shoulders hurt.

exercises.name: Leg Curl - Cable Machine (Standing)
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Attach a low cable cuff to one ankle.
2. Stand facing the machine and hold it for balance.
3. Keep your thighs together and start with your leg straight.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your knee and bring your heel behind you.
2. Pause without moving your hip.
3. Straighten your leg slowly, then switch sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your knee pointing toward the floor.
- Use a light weight.
- Do not swing your leg.

exercises.name: Leg Extension - Leg Extension Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Adjust the seat so your knees line up with the machine pivot.
2. Place the pad above your ankles and hold the handles.
3. Choose a light weight to start.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Straighten your legs slowly.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower the pad under control and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your back against the pad.
- Do not kick or swing the weight.
- Use a shorter range if your knees are uncomfortable.

exercises.name: Leg Raise Twist (Hanging)
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms straight.
2. Keep your legs together and your shoulders steady.
3. Brace your stomach before raising your legs.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Raise your legs and turn them toward one side.
2. Lower them slowly to the middle.
3. Repeat on the other side.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep the movement controlled.
- Do not swing your body.
- Bend your knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: Leg Raise Twist (Lying)
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with your legs straight.
2. Place your arms by your sides or hold a stable surface.
3. Brace your stomach before lifting your legs.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Raise your legs and lower them toward one side.
2. Bring them back to the middle.
3. Repeat on the other side without letting them touch the floor.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your lower back close to the floor.
- Use a smaller range if your back arches.
- Bend your knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: Lunge
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart.
2. Brace your stomach and keep a stable position.
3. Brace your stomach before moving.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Step one foot forward or to the side and lower your body slowly.
2. Keep the front foot flat and the knee pointed toward the toes.
3. Push through the front foot to return and switch sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a shorter step if your balance is limited.
- Hold a support while learning.
- Stop if your knee caves inward or becomes painful.

exercises.name: Lunge - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart.
2. Set the bar and plates safely before starting.
3. Brace your stomach before moving.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Step one foot forward or to the side and lower your body slowly.
2. Keep the front foot flat and the knee pointed toward the toes.
3. Push through the front foot to return and switch sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a shorter step if your balance is limited.
- Hold a support while learning.
- Stop if your knee caves inward or becomes painful.

exercises.setupNotes:

2. Set the cable and attachment at a comfortable height.
3. Brace your stomach before moving.
exercises.executionNotes:

2. Keep the front foot flat and the knee pointed toward the toes.
3. Push through the front foot to return and switch sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a shorter step if your balance is limited.
- Hold a support while learning.
- Stop if your knee caves inward or becomes painful.

exercises.setupNotes:

exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a shorter step if your balance is limited.
- Hold a support while learning.
- Stop if your knee caves inward or becomes painful.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie face down with a light dumbbell held securely between your feet.
2. Start with your legs straight and your hips against the bench or floor.
3. Hold a stable support with your hands.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your knees and bring your heels behind you.
2. Pause without letting the dumbbell shift.
3. Lower your legs slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Start with a very light dumbbell.
- Keep your hips down.
- Stop if you cannot hold the dumbbell securely.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl - Leg Curl Machine
aliases: Lying Leg Curl - Leg Curl Machine (lying)
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Adjust the machine so your knees line up with its pivot.
2. Place the pad above your heels and hold the handles.
3. Choose a light weight to start.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your knees and pull the pad toward you.
2. Pause briefly at the end.
3. Return the pad slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your hips against the pad.
- Do not lift your hips or swing the weight.
- Use a shorter range if your knees are uncomfortable.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Raise
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with your legs together.
2. Place your hands by your sides or under your hips.
3. Keep your back flat before lifting.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Raise your legs slowly.
2. Stop before your back lifts from the floor.
3. Lower your legs under control and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Bend your knees to make it easier.
- Do not swing your legs.
- Use a smaller range if your back arches.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Start in a plank with your hands under your shoulders.
2. Keep your body in a straight line.
3. Brace your stomach before moving.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bring one knee toward your chest.
2. Return it and switch legs.
3. Keep alternating at a steady pace.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Step instead of jumping for less impact.
- Keep your hips from bouncing up and down.
- Slow down if your plank position changes.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber (Crossbody)
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Start in a plank with your hands under your shoulders.
2. Keep your body in a straight line.
3. Brace your stomach before moving.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bring your right knee toward your left elbow.
2. Return it and switch sides.
3. Keep alternating at a steady pace.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Step instead of jumping for less impact.
- Keep your hips from bouncing up and down.
- Slow down if your plank position changes.

exercises.name: Muscle Up
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Use a bar with enough space above it.
2. Grip the bar firmly and start with your shoulders active.
3. Use a band or low bar while learning.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Pull your chest toward the bar while bringing your body forward.
2. Move your chest over the bar and press up.
3. Lower back to a controlled hang.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Build pull-up and dip strength first.
- Use a spotter or band for practice.
- Stop if your swing becomes hard to control.

exercises.name: Oblique Crunch
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
2. Place your hands behind your head without pulling on your neck.
3. Lift your shoulders slightly from the floor.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bring your right shoulder toward your left knee.
2. Return to the middle and switch sides.
3. Keep alternating slowly and smoothly.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your lower back close to the floor.
- Move your shoulders rather than pulling your head.
- Use a smaller range if your neck or back hurts.

exercises.name: Oblique V-Up
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with your legs extended or bent.
2. Brace your stomach and keep a stable position.
3. Keep your back flat and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lift your legs and upper body toward each other.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Bend your knees to make it easier.
- Use a smaller range while learning.
- Do not swing or pull on your neck.

exercises.name: Overhead Press - Barbell

2. Set the bar and plates safely before starting.
3. Brace your stomach and keep your feet planted.
exercises.executionNotes:

2. Stop when your arms are straight without shrugging.
3. Lower slowly to the start and repeat.

exercises.name: Overhead Squat - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
2. Hold the weight overhead with your arms straight.
3. Brace your stomach and keep your feet flat.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your hips and knees to lower your body.
2. Keep the weight over your head as you squat.
3. Push through the floor to stand tall.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a light weight or a stick while learning.
- Squat only as low as you can control.
- Stop if your arms or back position changes.

exercises.name: Overhead Squat - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
2. Hold the weight overhead with your arms straight.

- Use a smaller range if your back hurts.

2. Brace your stomach and keep a stable position.
3. Place your hands where they can support your head or sides without pulling.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lift your upper body or shoulder from the floor.
2. Move toward the target side or position.
3. Lower slowly and repeat on both sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your neck relaxed.
- Use a smaller range if your back lifts.
- Move slowly instead of pulling with your hands.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:

2. Set the bar and plates safely before starting.
3. Keep your upper arms still and your elbows pointed up.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your elbows to lower the weight near your forehead.
2. Straighten your arms without moving your upper arms.
3. Lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:

- Keep the weight under control near your head.
- Stop if your elbows or shoulders hurt.

exercises.tipsNotes:

exercises.name: Sled Pull
exercises.setupNotes:

2. Hold the handles or attach the harness securely.
3. Lean slightly into the movement and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:

2. Keep your back steady and your steps controlled.
3. Slow down and stop when you reach the end of the path.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep the path clear of people and obstacles.
- Use a lighter load if your posture changes.
- Do not sprint until you can control the sled.

2. Use a wide grip and keep your back flat.
3. Start with a light weight and a clear area.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Push the floor away and pull the bar close to your body.
2. Catch the bar overhead with soft knees.
3. Stand tall, then lower the bar safely.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Practice with a light bar before adding weight.
- Keep the bar close and move smoothly.
- Get coaching before using heavy weights.

exercises.name: Split Jerk
exercises.setupNotes:

2. Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and brace your stomach.
3. Use a rack and set the safety height before starting.
exercises.executionNotes:

2. Split your feet and catch the bar with straight arms.
3. Bring your feet together, then lower the bar safely.
exercises.tipsNotes:

- Keep the bar over your head when you catch it.
- Use a light weight until the landing is steady.

exercises.tipsNotes:

2. Keep your chest up and brace your stomach.
3. Keep your feet flat before you start.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your hips and knees to lower your body slowly.
2. Keep your knees pointed toward your toes.
3. Push through the floor to stand tall.
exercises.tipsNotes:

- Keep your heels down.

exercises.name: Squat - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
2. Set the bar and plates safely before starting.
3. Brace your stomach and keep your feet flat.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your hips and knees to lower your body.
2. Keep your knees pointed toward your toes.
3. Push through the floor to stand tall.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Squat only as low as you can control.
- Keep your heels down.
- Lower the weight if your form changes.

exercises.setupNotes:

2. Use a stable position and choose a load you can control.
3. Brace your stomach and keep your feet flat.
exercises.executionNotes:

2. Keep your knees pointed toward your toes.
3. Push through the floor to stand tall.
exercises.tipsNotes:

exercises.name: Squat Calf Press
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Sit in the leg press and place the balls of your feet on the platform.
2. Keep your legs nearly straight and unlock the safety stops.
3. Use a light load and keep your feet about hip-width apart.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Raise your heels as high as you can.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly without bouncing and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your ankles straight.
- Use a comfortable range of motion.
- Use the safety stops and a load you can control.

exercises.name: Step-Up
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand in front of a stable step or bench.
2. Brace your stomach and keep a stable position.
3. Place one whole foot on the step.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Push through the foot on the step to stand up.
2. Bring the other foot up without jumping.
3. Step down carefully and switch sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a low step while learning.
- Keep your knee pointed toward your toes.
- Hold a support if your balance is limited.

exercises.name: Stiff Leg Deadlift - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand with your feet about hip-width apart.
2. Set the bar and plates safely before starting.
3. Keep your back flat and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Move your hips back and keep the weight close.
2. Stand up by pushing through your feet.
3. Lower slowly by moving your hips back first, then repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Start with a light weight.
- Do not round your back or jerk the weight.
- Use a shorter range if your balance or form changes.

exercises.name: Straight Arm Lat Pull-down - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Sit with your thighs secured under the pad.
2. Set the cable and attachment at a comfortable height.
3. Grip the bar or handle and sit tall.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Pull the bar or handle toward your upper chest.
2. Pause briefly without leaning far back.
3. Let your arms straighten slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your shoulders down.
- Do not pull behind your neck.
- Use a lighter weight if you need to swing.

exercises.name: Straight Arm Lat Pull-down - Lat Pulldown Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Sit with your thighs secured under the pad.
2. Adjust the seat and pads to fit you.
3. Grip the bar or handle and sit tall.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Pull the bar or handle toward your upper chest.
2. Pause briefly without leaning far back.
3. Let your arms straighten slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:

- Do not pull behind your neck.
- Use a lighter weight if you need to swing.

exercises.name: Swings - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and hold the weight in front of you.
2. Keep your knees slightly bent and your back flat.
3. Start with a light weight and clear the area.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Hinge at your hips and swing the weight between your legs.
2. Drive your hips forward to bring it to chest height.
3. Let it swing back and repeat without lifting it with your arms.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep the weight close and the swing controlled.
- Do not squat deeply or lean back at the top.
- Stop if your back rounds or the weight pulls you off balance.

exercises.name: Thruster - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Hold the weight at shoulder height.
2. Set the bar and plates safely before starting.
3. Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lower into a comfortable squat.
2. Stand up and press the weight overhead.
3. Lower the weight to your shoulders and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a light weight while learning.
- Keep your feet flat and knees pointed toward your toes.
- Slow down if the press becomes uncontrolled.

exercises.name: Thruster - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:

exercises.name: Toes To Bar
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Hang from the bar with a firm grip.
2. Keep your shoulders active and your legs together.
3. Start with bent knees if needed.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lift your knees or feet toward the bar.
2. Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
3. Repeat from a controlled hang.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use bent knees to make it easier.
- Keep the movement smooth.
- Stop if your grip or shoulders become unsafe.

exercises.name: Tricep Dip
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Grip the parallel bars and support yourself with straight arms.
2. Use a stable position and choose a load you can control.
3. Lean slightly forward and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your elbows and lower yourself slowly.
2. Stop at a comfortable depth.
3. Press through the bars to return to the top.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use an assisted dip machine while learning.
- Do not bounce at the bottom.
- Stop if your shoulders hurt.

exercises.name: Tricep Dip - Assisted Dip/Pull-Up Machine
exercises.setupNotes:

2. Adjust the seat and pads to fit you.
3. Lean slightly forward and brace your stomach.

exercises.tipsNotes:

exercises.name: Tricep Kickback - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Stand, sit, or lie in a stable position.
2. Set the cable and attachment at a comfortable height.
3. Keep your upper arms still and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your elbows to lower the weight.
2. Straighten your arms without swinging.
3. Return slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your elbows close to the chosen position.
- Use a lighter weight if your shoulders move.
- Stop if your elbows or shoulders hurt.

exercises.name: Tuck Crunch
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with your knees bent.
2. Place your hands beside your body or behind your head.
3. Lift your feet slightly and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bring your knees toward your chest as you lift your shoulders.
2. Pause briefly when your body is tucked.
3. Lower your shoulders and legs slowly.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your neck relaxed.
- Use a smaller range if your back lifts.
- Move slowly instead of swinging your legs.

exercises.name: Tuck Crunch - Dumbbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with your knees bent.
2. Choose a weight you can control.
3. Place your hands where they can support your head or sides without pulling.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lift your upper body or shoulder from the floor.
2. Move toward the target side or position.
3. Lower slowly and repeat on both sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your neck relaxed.
- Use a smaller range if your back lifts.
- Move slowly instead of pulling with your hands.

exercises.name: Turkish Get Up
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with one knee bent and the weight held above that shoulder.
2. Keep the same-side arm straight and place the other hand on the floor.
3. Move slowly and use a light weight while learning.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Roll to your side and press up onto your hand.
2. Lift your hips, bring your leg under you, and stand up.
3. Reverse the steps slowly until you are lying down again.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your eyes on the weight.
- Use no weight until the steps feel steady.
- Stop if you lose control of the weight.

exercises.name: Up-Down Twist - Cable Machine
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Set up on the floor or at the bar or cable station.
2. Set the cable and attachment at a comfortable height.
3. Brace your stomach and start with a small range.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Raise or move your legs while keeping your upper body steady.
2. Turn slowly toward one side.
3. Return to the middle and switch sides.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a smaller range while learning.
- Do not swing or twist quickly.
- Stop if your back or shoulders lose control.

exercises.name: Upright Row - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Set your body so your back is flat and your chest is supported or steady.
2. Set the bar and plates safely before starting.
3. Let your arms reach forward without rounding your back.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Pull the handle or weight toward your ribs.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Keep your shoulders down.
- Do not twist or jerk the weight.
- Use a lighter weight if your back moves.

exercises.name: V Up
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with your legs extended or bent.
2. Brace your stomach and keep a stable position.
3. Keep your back flat and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lift your legs and upper body toward each other.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Bend your knees to make it easier.
- Use a smaller range while learning.
- Do not swing or pull on your neck.

exercises.name: Windshield Wipers
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides.
2. Raise your legs with your knees bent or straight.
3. Keep your back flat before moving.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Lower your legs slowly to one side.
2. Bring them back to the middle.
3. Lower them to the other side and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Bend your knees to make it easier.
- Move only as far as you can keep your back flat.
- Use slow movements instead of swinging.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Sit with your forearms supported and your hands over the edge.
2. Set the bar and plates safely before starting.
3. Keep your wrists straight at the start.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Curl your hands up slowly.
2. Pause briefly at the top.
3. Lower your hands under control and repeat.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a light weight.
- Keep your forearms still.
- Stop if your wrists hurt.

exercises.name: Zercher Carry - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Choose a load you can carry safely.
2. Stand tall and hold the weight securely.
3. Clear a straight walking path.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Walk forward with steady steps.
2. Keep the weights close and your body tall.
3. Stop and set the weights down carefully.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use a shorter path while learning.
- Do not lean or rush.
- Set the weights down instead of dropping them.

exercises.name: Zercher Squat - Barbell
exercises.setupNotes:
1. Set the bar in a rack at a safe height.
2. Hold it in the crooks of your elbows and step back.
3. Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and brace your stomach.
exercises.executionNotes:
1. Bend your hips and knees to lower your body.
2. Keep the bar close and your feet flat.
3. Push through the floor to stand tall.
exercises.tipsNotes:
- Use padding on the bar if needed.
- Squat only as low as you can control.
- Lower the weight if your back position changes.
